primary_interest.quote: you're building voice AI agents for appointment booking

use_case.quote: We want an agent that picks up, finds an open slot, books it, and sends a confirmation.

edge_framing.quote: Within a Voice AI agent, Edge Compute is where small functions live right next to the agent.

edge_raised_by.quote: Edge Compute. Have you thought about how those tool calls run?

competitors_edge.quote: Fastly and Cloudflare Workers, both. My team prototyped on Cloudflare Workers already.

decision_criteria.quote: How proven is this? Are people running production AI voice workloads on it, at my scale? I don't want to be the guinea pig.

stated_reason.quote: But let me ask the thing I really care about. How proven is this?
